rules.poll: key status every 15 min; on recovery the paid chain resumes automatically (panel prefixes, API judges, repair, relabel); cached calls are never re-billed

rules.population_if_cutoff: the completed random prefix: the first K sentences of the frozen sha1 order whose panel prefix finished (K = 110 unless more prefixes complete), all strata; the completed fraction per stratum is reported. Rows of sentences outside the prefix are not analysed (no completion selection).
rules.primary_if_cutoff: (a) is evaluated exactly as pre-registered on the rows that have a flash-lite disguised score (a random sha1(row_key)-ordered subset); if that cell fails the testability rule (>=50 ERROR and >=50 CORRECT rows, >=25 sentences each) (a) is NOT_TESTABLE and the overall verdict is PARTIAL/NOT_TESTABLE, never CONFIRM.
rules.fallback_comparator: the local Qwen3-8B rubric-A judge (T1's local judge, disguised view primary, original secondary) is reported as a DECLARED SUBSTITUTE bar: V0 - local judge strat Delta with CI. It is secondary evidence and cannot produce CONFIRM.
rules.S4_if_cutoff: S4_E2 uses the features with >=95% coverage on R_AB (entry rule of T1): in the blocked state that is the local judge (both views), L2-bow, L3; (b) is reported with that feature list.
